displayName: OCI-LAT-CHN-016: Lateral movement chain — Cloud API → Resource Hijacking → Cryptomining
description:
Detects cloud API compromise followed by resource hijacking and cryptomining activity

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: lateral movement chain — cloud api → resource hija

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_lat_chn_016", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%lateral%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%movement%') AND "value" > 0
